0.content: Alice, founder of the Hexenzirkel, found Nicole wandering after the angels' fall. She listened to all her stories over a drink and a bag of biscuits, asked whether they were true, and declared that a mage and an angel "match perfectly". She invited Nicole to her brand-new club and sealed the "mages' pact" by pressing her last piece of candy into Nicole's hand, without waiting for an answer Nicole could not give. Nicole says Alice "corrupted" her. Alice compared her to the sea's daughter who traded her voice for legs: "the daughter of the heavens sacrificed her voice to become human."

1.content: At the Hexenzirkel's tea parties Nicole is the quiet, mysterious one, at least on the surface. She knows everyone's tea (Alice three sugars, Anya one, Barbeloth none). She once asked the mages what the world was for: M (Andersdotter) said not to give it human motives, O (Octavia) said "to resist destruction", B (Barbeloth) didn't care, and R (Rhinedottir) thought it would make a nice test. Alice answered by taking her sightseeing at the border of other worlds.

2.comment: Nicole: The angels' fall and Nicole's bargain
2.content: The angels were made to guide humanity. After the rebellion of the war of funerary flame, the heavens punished all of them. Those who refused to give up power lost their wisdom and became beasts or dragons such as Ursa. Others became Seelie, sank into the sea, hid in the sands or melded with the earth. Nicole surrendered half her wisdom and half her power. She offered her voice as a "bargaining chip", since "the heavens demanded silence and punishment", and kept her form. She now calls herself a human who lost her voice.

3.comment: Nicole: Columbina's name and the Hyperborean portal
3.content: When the Traveler sought a way to return the fading Moon Goddess beyond the false sky, Nicole explained that Hyperboreans after the war of funerary flame had built kuuvahki structures to contact the moons, only to learn the three goddesses were dead. Their ritual could become a portal. She found phantoms to project into the past, tested candidates by kuuvahki infusion ("Cheating the system is much easier than trying to hide from it") and chose the Traveler, Lauma and Arlecchino. In the ruins she saw that Columbina had never had a true name, and that one could simply be given: "Names are anchors that connect us to the world."

4.content: "Mr. Nine", the famous author Fischl idolises, is a pen name. Nicole wanted to be an author but found writing too tedious, so she told her stories to an old Seelie friend, a fellow former angel. The Seelie possessed sleeping would-be authors to write them, recovering her own capacity for speech along the way. Fischl found the Seelie in Nod-Krai. Nicole admitted that one "Mr. Nine" book held a half-true metaphor for the creation of life, which is how Fischl made Oz: "70 percent made-up, 30 percent true." Nicole insists the book was her idea; now that the Seelie has her intellect back, they argue about plot and first authorship.
